say:3:1320425001:0.text: I thought you were off reporting to your superiors. What brings you back? Don't tell me there are more monsters around...
say:3:1320425001:0.source_cn: 你们不是去向侍卫长汇报了吗，怎么回来了？难道附近还有冰...

say:4:1320425002:0.text: Oh, no, no! They're all taken care of, and I already gave my report.
say:4:1320425002:0.source_cn: 不，不不不！这件事已经彻底解决了，侍卫长那边也已经汇报完毕。

say:5:1320425003:1.text: I actually came to present these everfrost pinecones as a token of our gratitude.
say:5:1320425003:1.source_cn: 我这次来，是想将这些珍霜松果送给各位，以此作为感谢。

say:6:1320425004:0.source_cn: 珍霜松果……那是什么？听上去好好吃！

say:7:1320425005:0.text: *Laughs* Oh, little one, they're not for eating. These are a special gift.
say:7:1320425005:0.source_cn: 哈哈，小家伙，这可不是用来吃的，而是一种珍贵的礼物。

say:8:1320425006:1.text: In Whiteridge, we give everfrost pinecones to heroes—people who have done great things for us.
say:8:1320425006:1.source_cn: 是的。在白山公国，我们会将珍霜松果送给英雄和对自己有恩的人。

say:9:1320425007:0.text: Your contribution in clearing out the remains of the Frost Furie's minions cannot be overlooked, so I gathered these for you. I hope you'll accept them.
say:9:1320425007:0.source_cn: 在清除恶魔眷属这件事上，几位的贡献不可忽视，所以我特意...

choice_prompt:10:1320425007.text: Your contribution in clearing out the remains of the Frost Furie's minions cannot be overlooked, so I gathered these for you. I hope you'll accept them.
choice_prompt:10:1320425007.source_cn: 在清除恶魔眷属这件事上，几位的贡献不可忽视，所以我特意采摘了这些松果，还望你们能够收下！

say:12:1320425010:0.text: What is it, Madam Gerda? Is there something wrong with the pinecones?
say:12:1320425010:0.source_cn: 怎么了？格尔达女士，这些松果哪里不对吗？

say:13:1320425011:0.text: No, no. I just detected a faint sulfur smell.
say:13:1320425011:0.source_cn: 没什么，我只是在松果上闻到了很淡的硫磺气味。

say:14:1320425012:0.text: Sulfur?! Could that mean a hot spring where these pinecones were found?
say:14:1320425012:0.source_cn: 真的吗？！那是不是说明，在采摘松果的地方周围就有温泉？

say:15:1320425013:0.text: Not necessarily. Lots of things carry a sulfur smell, so it might not mean anything. But... maybe it's worth a look.
say:15:1320425013:0.source_cn: 也不一定。有很多东西都包含硫磺，未必和温泉有关。不过嘛...

say:16:1320425014:1.text: Do you remember where exactly you picked these cones?
say:16:1320425014:1.source_cn: 领队，你还记得采摘松果的地方在哪吗？

say:17:1320425015:0.text: Sure do. It was near the frozen river north of the inn, by the waterfall along the riverbank.

say:18:1320425016:0.text: Then let's head over there! There could really be a hidden hot spring!
say:18:1320425016:0.source_cn: 那我们就赶快过去吧！说不定真的能找到野温泉呢！

choice:10:1:2.text: I suppose I can take these...
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 那我就勉为其难地收下吧

choice:10:1:2.female: I suppose I can take these...
